A controller connected after the game has started is not picked up (reported on an M1 Pro, macOS 26.7, DXVK, engine r28)
Occasional flickering and stuttering (reported on an M1 Pro, macOS 26.7, DXVK, engine r28)

notes: The upstream record does not specify a renderer. DXMT is the starting default.
